title: Night guard for teeth grinding
what: This is a thin, clear cover for your teeth that you wear at night. It protects your teeth from wear when you clench or grind in your sleep.
why: When you grind or clench your teeth, your teeth are wearing down, or your jaw or head hurts in the morning.
duration: taking impressions usually takes 15 to 20 minutes; the guard is usually ready in a few days
tell_doctor: If you grind your teeth. Someone close to you may have noticed
Jaw pain or clicking, or morning headaches
If you have braces, crowns, or implants

prepare.title: Teeth
prepare.text: Brush your teeth before the visit.

prepare.title: Questions
prepare.text: Write down what bothers you: pain, noises, worn teeth.

bring: Your old guard, if you have one
steps: The doctor checks your teeth and jaw
Impressions or a scan of your teeth are taken
The guard is made in a lab to fit your teeth
At the next visit, you try it on
The doctor adjusts it so it does not press
You are shown how to put it in, take it out, and clean it
feel: The impression material may make you gag. Breathe through your nose
The first few nights, the guard feels strange
You may have more saliva. This passes in a few days
after: In the morning, rinse it in cool water and brush it
Keep it in its case, not in hot water
See your dentist for checks as advised
red_flags: The guard presses, or your teeth or jaw hurt more than before: book a visit with your dentist

faq.a: It protects your teeth, but does not remove the cause. Your doctor may suggest other steps too.

faq.q: Can I buy a ready-made guard at the pharmacy?
faq.a: Ready-made guards exist, but a custom one fits better. Ask your dentist.

faq.q: How long does a guard last?
faq.a: Usually a year or more. If it cracks or stops fitting well, you need a new one.

reminders.text: Night guard visit in 2 hours. Brush your teeth before you go.
